..title
A resolution exempting 178 Second Avenue North, Unit #205, from the minimum distance requirements for obtaining a Short Term Rental Property – Not Owner-Occupied permit pursuant to Metropolitan Code of Laws Section 6.28.030(B)(2)(d).
..body
WHEREAS, Metropolitan Code of Laws Section 6.28.030(B)(2)(d), provides that no new STRP – not owner-occupied, permit shall be issued to an applicant whose location is less than one hundred feet from a religious institution, a school or its playground, a park, or a licensed day care center or its playground unless the Metropolitan Council approves an exemption from the minimum distance requirements upon the adoption of a resolution, after a public hearing, receiving 21 affirmative votes; and
WHEREAS, Jeffrey Rasmussen has filed an application with the Metropolitan Department of Codes Administration for a STRP, non-owner occupied, permit for property located at 178 Second Avenue North, Unit #205, pursuant to Metropolitan Code of Laws Section 6.28.030(B)(2)(d); and
WHEREAS, in accordance with Metropolitan Code of Laws Section 6.28.030(B)(2)(d), a public hearing was held at the October 6, 2026 meeting of the Metropolitan Council regarding the exemption of 178 Second Avenue North, Unit #205, from the minimum distance requirements to obtain a STRP – not owner-occupied permit.
NOW, THEREFORE BE IT RESOLVED BY THE METROPOLITAN COUNCIL OF THE METROPOLITAN GOVERNMENT OF NASHVILLE AND DAVIDSON COUNTY:
Section 1. Pursuant to Metropolitan Code of Laws Section 6.28.030(B)(2)(d), the Metropolitan Council hereby approves the exemption of 178 Second Avenue North, Unit #205, from the minimum distance requirements for obtaining a STRP – not owner-occupied permit.
Section 2. The Metropolitan Clerk is directed to send a copy of this Resolution to the Director of the Department of Codes Administration. 
Section 3. This Resolution shall take effect from and after its passage, the welfare of the Metropolitan Government of Nashville and Davidson County requiring it.
..Agenda Analysis
Analysis

This resolution exempts 178 2nd Avenue North, Unit 205, from the minimum distance requirements for obtaining a Short Term Rental Property - Not Owner-Occupied permit pursuant to Metropolitan Code of Laws Section 6.28.030(B)(2)(d).

Metropolitan Code of Laws Section 6.28.030(B)(2)(d) provides that no new STRP - not owner-occupied permit shall be issued to an applicant whose location is less than one hundred feet from a religious institution, a school or its playground, a park, or a licensed day care center or its playground. The Council may approve an exemption from the minimum distance requirements upon adoption of a resolution, after a public hearing, receiving 21 affirmative votes.

This exemption is requested because 178 2nd Avenue North, Unit 205, is within 100 feet of a park.
